seed_meaning: three inner-split seeds on the same cohort, not independent cohorts or neural initializations
gene_set_source: existing, hash-locked Hallmark metadata; no target-driven gene set selection
rna_scoring: log2(RSEM+1), train-only median imputation and gene z scores, duplicate symbols averaged, mean score per fixed set
rna_negative_values: preserve batch-normalized values in (-1,0); require finite values > -1; no clipping or target-driven transform changes
raw_rna: Top512 variance on train-only log2 median-imputed expression BEFORE standardization
shuffled_gene_control: fold-local global gene derangement within 5x5 train mean/SD rank bins; preserves set sizes and inter-set overlap; usable measured symbols only
cna_scoring: signed continuous log2 copy-number values; train-only gene z scores averaged by fixed set; dosage evidence, NOT pathway activity; RNA/CNA remain separate
bridge_formula: features=[standardized static S, standardized molecular Z, lambda*S*tanh(Z_R*A.T)/static_scale, lambda*S*tanh(Z_CNA*A.T)/static_scale]; separate main effects retained
bridge_scope: fixed bounded concept-evidence interactions + fitted tiny linear head; no learned TITAN token prompt or encoder adaptation
shuffled_mapping: degree-preserving edge swaps; same per-concept and per-state edge counts, zero rows preserved
wrong_patient: same fitted B2 weights and scaler; only bridge conditioning uses a deterministic cyclic shift of test omics; pathology and molecular additive main effects remain matched
classifier: class-balanced L2 multinomial logistic regression, LBFGS tol=1e-6, max_iter=5000; convergence required in every fit
selection: one shared stratified inner split per seed/endpoint/fold; all preprocessing fitted on inner-train, select C by inner-val BA with ties favoring smaller C; refit identical algorithm on outer-train

bootstrap.scheme: class-stratified paired patients, shared resamples across the three seed predictions, average seed difference
bootstrap.scope: conditional descriptive interval, not pipeline retraining or formal multiplicity control

decision: RNA biological representation compared independently with raw RNA and matched shuffled sets; CNA incremental benefit is a separate question; bridge must exceed static, raw-RNA additive, molecular additive, shuffled mapping and conditioning-only wrong-patient controls

clinical_text.reason: optional supplement; no safely audited target-free text input has been established

publication: aggregate reports, source, fixed gene lists and protocol only; patient IDs, raw data, preprocessing parameters and OOF remain server-private
